title: Addition Word Problems with Sums up to 20
seo_title: Grade 1 Addition Word Problems Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Solve problems (given orally or in pictures) involving addition with sums up to 20.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 addition word problems for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: joining, putting parts together and number sentences with sums up to 20. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Write a number sentence, then check.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Read the story. Find what is asked.
  • “In all”, “altogether” and “now” often mean add.
  • Draw or use counters if it helps.
  • Write a number sentence: 7 + 5 = 12. Check that the answer makes sense.

Examples

Example

Ana has 7 mangoes. She gets 5 more. How many now?

7 + 5

Answer: 12 mangoes

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
A number from the storyWork out the answer, do not copy a number.
SubtractingJoining means adding.
Wrong sentenceMatch the numbers to the story.
